svg.title: IP addresses, ports and listeners.
svg.desc: A TCP port selects a service at an IP address. A listener is a program waiting for connections. A local-client arrow reaches the Python server at 127.0.0.1:8000, serving index.html containing Hello. ss inspects this TCP listener; missing commands refer to Package Management. If using a replacement port, change the server, client URL and inspection filter consistently.
svg.text: A TCP port selects a service at an IP address. A listener waits for connections.
Second terminal, with the local demo running:
Address: this computer. Port: 8000. Serves index.html containing Hello.
Lists listening TCP sockets; process details may need permission.
Requires ss and curl. Missing? See Package Management / 01–02.
Port busy? Don't stop unknown processes. Change port in every server, URL and filter.
